Luxury Living in a 2 bedroom 2.5 bathroom Apartment!

2F - 2118 West 15 Ave, Vancouver

LIVE AT THE RIDGE. Built by Cressey, this concrete boutique building is impressive w/high-end finishing and thoughtful features incl. heating/cooling system, in floor heating and high ceilings. Spacious corner unit. Stunning kitchen w/apps (Wolf), lots of cupboards and drawers, marble and stone surfaces. Fantastic layout: open concept living/dining w/adjacent patio. Office space tucked out of sight, bdrms on opposite sides both w/ensuites. Master bdrm features ensuite w/large shower and walk-in closet. Floor to ceiling windows throughout w/tasteful window coverings, lots of natural light. Mt views and peek-a-boo water view in winter from living rm, office and master bdrm. 1 large storage locker and 2 parking stalls. Convenient location close to shopping, transit, bike lanes. A walker's paradise. Gym in building and grocery downstairs!

Available from November 1st!!
Minimum of ONE Year LEASE required.

To schedule viewing, please visit https://www.noblehomes.ca/en/listing_detail/c43e8984-7b57-e711-8121-e0071b6ad011.

You can also send an email to Rental@Noblehomes.ca or TEXT your full name and address of interested property to 778-800-1997. Thank you!
